name: dsh-profile
description: Single source of truth for a DeepSeek Harness web profile: profiles/web/plugins.intent.json is the only hand-maintained file; package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml are generated from it. This repo contains ONLY the profile compiler — host deployment, host doctoring and audits live elsewhere.

scripts.test: node scripts/derive-profile.mjs && node scripts/check-profile.mjs && node scripts/derive-profile.mjs --profile pure && node scripts/check-profile.mjs --profile pure && node scripts/check-profile.selftest.mjs && node scripts/derive-profile.selftest.mjs
scripts.check:pure: node scripts/derive-profile.mjs --profile pure && node scripts/check-profile.mjs --profile pure
